title: Test first: roles take a route and a model each; Casper stays local
goal: Failing tests first, then config validation: misato and consultant accept {route, model}; model must be a local name or one of claude-haiku-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-opus-5-5; casper with a cloud route is refused
acceptance: A failing test first for each: consultant on cloud, per-role cloud model, unknown cloud model refused, Casper cloud refused with an error naming the rule
Old configs (consultant: {model}, one models.cloud.model) still load and behave as before
The config schema, models report and docs/agents/areas.md (Local core) state the Casper rule
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
